hero.lead:
I study web development and information security,
focusing on services that look good on the surface
and run safely underneath.
hero.imageAlt: Illustration of a person on a rooftop overlooking a city at dusk

about.fallbackBio:
I study web development and information security together.
Beyond the features you see on screen, I try to understand
how requests travel and how data is stored.

I like to build even small features myself and write down why
they work the way they do. I'm still learning, but I want to be
a developer who can explain what they've built.
